free_tier.stated: No free tier and no trial are published on the pricing page: Mac mini M4 entry is 85 /mo USD, excl. tax, with a 24-hour minimum rental. Eligible free and open-source projects get 25% off every plan and add-on through our Open Source Program, in exchange for a credit and a backlink.
free_tier.notes: The daily rate is $14 for 24 hours, auto-renew off; the provider list's $85 a month divided by 730 hours is $0.116 an hour. The 25% open-source discount is a price reduction, not a free allowance.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a dedicated physical Mac with a 256 GB SSD, not an object

retention.stated: with a daily plan auto-renew off, the instance and all its data are deleted when the 24 hours paid for end; with auto-renew on, the Mac and its data are erased when a renewal payment fails, and monthly and annual plans keep a 24-hour or 3-day grace period

egress.terms: Unmetered 1 Gbps Network: No data cap, on a 100 Gbps backbone, upgradable to 2.5 or 5 Gbps; 2.5 Gbps for +$20/mo or 5 Gbps for +$35/mo, unmetered as well

interface_detail: full root access via SSH and VNC; public IPv4 and IPv6 addresses; scp and SFTP for file transfer; a dashboard at app.myremotemac.com; VNC desktop on port 59010 and SSH on port 22
tooling: an SSH client, a VNC viewer and scp or SFTP; the GitHub Actions self-hosted runner guide sets up launchd, Xcode and caches. The user installs and runs the CI runner agent on the rented Mac; the Mac itself is the hosted offer.
chaining: the dedicated Mac runs a GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or Buildkite self-hosted runner with Xcode, and the unmetered 1 Gbps link makes it usable as a build and test host; artifacts needing durable storage should be copied to an object-storage record because the instance is deleted at the end of a daily term.

limits.value: 24-hour minimum rental; $14 for 24 hours, auto-renew off, or $85 a month
fail2ban bans the caller IP for 1 hour after 5 failed logins within 10 minutes on SSH and VNC

limits_note: You can run one daily Mac at a time; monthly or yearly is needed for another Mac. Add-ons such as the backup disk and network upgrades are available on monthly and annual plans only, not daily plans.
binding_note: the 24-hour minimum and the $14 daily or $85 monthly price are the first limit a caller meets; the unmetered network does not impose a byte quota.

identity_cost.detail: the register form asks for First Name, Last Name, Email, Password and Confirm Password; the pricing FAQ states payment is by all major credit cards via Stripe, with wire transfers for enterprise accounts, and that every card goes through 3D Secure verification with a $1 hold released right away

reliability_note: a daily instance and all its data are deleted when the paid 24 hours end, immediately at later renewals if a payment fails; fail2ban bans the caller IP for 1 hour after 5 failed logins in 10 minutes; the vendor states a 99.9% uptime SLA.
confidence_note: prices, network terms, rental minimum, deletion behaviour and payment rails are quoted from first-party pricing and FAQ pages; the SSH/VNC ports and fail2ban rule are quoted from the vendor's docs; the signup form and payment rails were read but no rental was made.
